exchanges.prompt: Build entirely NEW from blank standalone /workspace/scratch/511edc76527a/referralflow-fresh/dist/B.html. Do not read any prior html, prototypes, site or backup anywhere. Product ReferralFlow AI, Dental Demand Labs MENG570. 3 distinct hypothesis prototypes. B persona Dr. Elena Ruiz, referring general dentist (persona hypothesis). Fixed concept: existing specialist notes → draft report → specialist review/edit/recipient confirm/approve → approved info back to general dentist via practice channel. Build professional recipient-first 'Referral Brief' portal: warm ivory, charcoal, terracotta accent, elegant editorial type, concise approved handoff cards 'Visit summary / What your office needs to do / What specialist does next / Unresolved information'. Specialist preparation tab lets user generate structured draft from fictional existing notes, edit fields/owners, approve. Recipient portal unavailable until specialist approval and simulate handoff explicit button. Use consultation case with image requested, plan deferred, no date set; avoid clinical advice. Generation deterministic template/fixture, labelled demo not real AI. No sending, no production auth. Navigation direct links index.html A.html B.html C.html guide.html. No external dependencies/browser/deploy. Expose window.demo API for Node VM meaningful tests. First build core high-quality flow and wait for next prompt.

Recipient action owner and timing must be consistent with approved fields, and reset clears portal and response state. Add concise visible reasons when unavailable.
